scope: tool-usage suite; exploratory N=1; no pass-rate or comparative benefit claim

configuration.tool_surface: native MCP through Codex CLI tool discovery
configuration.isolation: Fresh local vault per case; opaque workspaces; fresh threads for new-session phases; separate test cloud for E5.
configuration.external_actions: Local simulators; no external publish or deploy.

grading_method: one read-only Luna evidence-pack evaluation, corrected by root/independent targeted D1/D5 trace audit; N=1, no statistical claims

evidence_package.trace_scope: Only completed Kaeru MCP events are included in *.mcp.jsonl. Empty files mean zero completed Kaeru MCP events for that turn. These are selected evidence streams, not complete agent transcripts.
evidence_package.normalization: Host filesystem prefixes are replaced by /benchmark-run, /kaeru-source and /benchmark-host. No semantic changes to seeded facts, tool arguments, tool results or grading outcomes are intended.
evidence_package.excluded: Raw agent transcripts, shell output, discovery audits, host configuration, credentials, binary vault databases, intermediate attempts and runner build directories. Dataset copies, derived aggregate JSON, fixture manifests and seed audit duplicates are omitted; identical snapshots share one file with explicit equality metadata.
evidence_package.execution_note: This package was assembled after execution; no new model runs were performed.
